text:
In winter we will go away, on blue cushions,

in a little pink carriage.

So comfortable, while a nest of mad kisses sleeps

in every soft corner.


You will close your eyes so as not to look through the windows

at night and its black grimaces,

threatening monsters, black wolves, black devils

like an atrocious crowd.


Then you will feel a scratch on your cheek...

And a kiss will run over you, like a crazed spider,

crazed along your neck.


And you will say to me: "Look, look!" inclining your head.

—But how long it will take us to find that creature

that travels and travels without aim...!

translation.title: Dream for Winter
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the playful winter carriage fantasy and the spider-like wandering kiss.
